hints.title: Prefix Row Slicing
hints.text: Displaying the initial segment of rows is a common exploratory step. Which DataFrame method extracts the top N records from a table?

hints.title: Head Method Application
hints.text: The head method extracts the specified number of top rows without modifying the original DataFrame.

hints.title: Prefix Parameter Configuration
hints.text: Call employees.head(3) to return a DataFrame slice containing at most the first three rows.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total rows in employees table
complexity.notes: Extracts a fixed constant slice of at most 3 rows.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning or re-indexing the entire table creates unnecessary memory copies for an operation that only requires 3 rows.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Returning a shallow view or 3-row slice avoids allocating full table replicas.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of standard idiomatic head(3) or iloc[:3] handling tables with fewer than 3 rows gracefully.
